name: read_file
description: One case for the whole read_file contract: a read at a byte offset past 64 KiB (src/agent/loop.zig is over 100 KB, and no tool could see past that ceiling until the guest arena stopped being 64 KiB), and the pagination signal that tells a caller there is more to come. Both were silently broken while every build gate stayed green.
prompt: Use the read_file tool twice on src/agent/loop.zig. First with offset 70000 and limit 20000: does that text contain the string 'parallel_tool_stack_bytes'? Second with offset 0 and limit 1024: does that result JSON contain the field 'next_offset'? Answer with only YES if both are true, otherwise NO.
